main_measure.name: mean signed 24-bar return of Monday 00:00 cases minus coin's mean non-overlapping 24-bar return, before costs
main_measure.threshold: confirm: positive with t >= 2 and positive check; reject: negative with t <= -2; else inconclusive; at least 100 cases

supporting_check.name: mean signed excess return above minus below each coin's median 720-bar volatility

decided_by: The main measure is positive with t >= 2 and the supporting check is positive.
reading: The Monday 00:00 bar is the bar whose start timestamp + 1h is Monday 00:00 UTC; the Sunday move's sign is the recorded raw component (24-bar return from closes when missing); a case needs a non-zero position and forecast on that bar, the 24 bars are counted in rows of the same window, cases are pooled over coins, the volatility needs a full 720 hourly returns inside the window, and cases exactly at a coin's median are in neither group.
